title: Location non catastrophe detail fields
text:
Location non catastrophe detail fields

Validation rules for fields that store non-catastrophe-related information for a
 location.

Select an exposure view, a contract in the contract list, the 
Contract
 Details
 pane, and then the location.

Note:
 We retired non-catastrophe loss analyses in 
Touchstone
 2021 (9.0). Therefore, these fields do
 not affect losses.

| Field | Description | Validation rules | Default value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Public Protection Class Code | One of the following codes to represent the level of
 protection that the local fire department provides for this location: 1 1X 1Y 2 2X 2Y 3 3X 3Y 4 4X 4Y 5 5X 5Y 6 6X 6Y 7 7X 7Y 8 8B 8X 8Y 9 10 10W Class 1 represents the best public protection, and Class 10 indicates
 no recognized protection. | Optional | |
| NonCat Ground Up Loss | Non-catastrophe ground-up loss for this location | Optional Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface | 0 |
